prompt:
People in many countries now eat a large share of their meals in cafés and restaurants, or buy food that is ready to heat, instead of cooking at home.

Why is this happening? Is it a positive or a negative development?
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Both questions must be answered separately: first the reasons, then whether it is a positive or negative development

Reasons: long and irregular working hours, ready meals becoming cheaper and more widely available, home delivery becoming easier, cooking no longer being learned at home, the rise in single-person households
Positive side: time saved, exposure to a wider range of flavours, employment in food preparation, sharing of household work
Negative side: loss of control over ingredients, salt and fat increasing without people noticing, higher cost in the long run, cooking skills not passing on to the next generation, packaging waste
A clear evaluation must be given in the conclusion; if both sides are argued, it should state which one outweighs the other
common_mistakes: Writing the reasons but not giving the positive/negative judgement
Reducing the topic to just the sentence 'ready meals are unhealthy'
Using a real restaurant or product name
